dedupe_keys.name: wise freshwater water information system for europe water framework directive data dashboards and map viewers

description: WISE Freshwater is the EEA and European Commission portal for data and information on Europe's rivers, lakes and groundwaters, the pressures on them and the measures taken to protect them. Coverage: EU Member States with Norway and Iceland in the reference spatial data; the Water Framework Directive section gives status and pressure results at EU, Member State and river basin district level from the data reported for the River Basin Management Plans, including ecological and chemical status of surface waters, chemical and quantitative status of groundwater, significant pressures and impacts, heavily modified and artificial water bodies and physical alterations; the WISE WFD reference spatial datasets contain river basin districts and sub-units, surface water bodies, groundwater bodies and monitoring sites. The portal also carries country profiles on urban waste water treatment (2022 data, updated May 2026) and the Nitrates Directive (July 2026), expert dashboards on WFD exemptions, and map viewers for the WFD, EU flood risk areas and drought impacts. Format and access: web pages, dashboards and map viewers, with the underlying WFD data through EEA's DiscoData service and the EEA spatial data catalogue; free. Licence: not read; the metadata record read gives no reuse terms. Caveats: results reflect Member State reporting cycles (third River Basin Management Plans), so reference years differ between countries and topics. Simulation uses: water body, river basin and monitoring site layers plus status and pressure data for hazard exposure, drought and flood adaptation and water supply capacity planning. Related records: the UWWTD treatment plants (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants), Waterbase UWWTD agglomerations (data-waterbase-uwwtd-agglomerations) and England's Catchment Data Explorer (data-england-catchment-data-explorer-river-basin-management).
